g.text: Title: 2 V100 SXM2 - NVLink reference starter

g.desc: Title: 2 V100 SXM2 - NVLink reference starter

g.text: Logical NVLink reference; no hardware qualification or footprint assignment

g.desc: Logical NVLink reference; no hardware qualification or footprint assignment

g.text: Full six-group two-GPU arrangement is derived from the documented pairing families.

g.desc: Full six-group two-GPU arrangement is derived from the documented pairing families.

g.text: This complete topology is not claimed as hardware-tested. Physical connector orientation and mating footprints require confirmation.

g.desc: This complete topology is not claimed as hardware-tested. Physical connector orientation and mating footprints require confirmation.

g.text: Curated from the credited community sources; see the repository sources, connection guide and standalone workbook.

g.desc: Curated from the credited community sources; see the repository sources, connection guide and standalone workbook.

g.text: External NVLink clock required on EVERY V100: 156.25 MHz differential / Connector B E20=P, F20=N.

g.desc: External NVLink clock required on EVERY V100: 156.25 MHz differential / Connector B E20=P, F20=N.

g.text: Separate PCIe clock: 100 MHz differential / Connector A E7=P, F7=N. Clock circuits are not included.

g.desc: Separate PCIe clock: 100 MHz differential / Connector A E7=P, F7=N. Clock circuits are not included.

g.text: Use suitable source/fanout outputs per GPU; also provide the required supplies, reset and supporting controls.

g.desc: Use suitable source/fanout outputs per GPU; also provide the required supplies, reset and supporting controls.

g.text: DATA WIRING ONLY - NOT A COMPLETE WORKING NVLINK IMPLEMENTATION

g.desc: DATA WIRING ONLY - NOT A COMPLETE WORKING NVLINK IMPLEMENTATION

g.text: 2-GPU NVLink starter | 1,600 labelled contacts | 192 connected conductors

g.desc: 2-GPU NVLink starter | 1,600 labelled contacts | 192 connected conductors

g.text: Open a GPU sheet, then connector A or B. Identical global labels join the NVLink data pins between GPUs.

g.desc: Open a GPU sheet, then connector A or B. Identical global labels join the NVLink data pins between GPUs.

g.text: Clock, power, ground, PCIe and control contacts remain labelled and unconnected for your own circuitry.

g.desc: Clock, power, ground, PCIe and control contacts remain labelled and unconnected for your own circuitry.
